visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Return the Condition Directly
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The function uses a chain of ifs to return 1 or 0. Simplify it so it returns the logical expression directly. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A comparison already produces 1 or 0 in C, so the whole ladder collapses into one boolean expression that mirrors the rule: divisible by 4 and not by 100, or divisible by 400.
